---
title: "Ejemplo Interactivo de Función"
format: html
---

Selecciona la imagen en $B$ para cada elemento del conjunto $A$:

```{=html}
<div style="font-family: sans-serif; max-width: 450px; margin: 10px 0; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff;">
  <div style="margin-bottom: 15px; display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: space-between;">
    <label><b>f(a):</b> 
      <select id="fa" onchange="actualizarDiagrama()">
        <option value="x">x</option>
        <option value="y">y</option>
        <option value="z">z</option>
        <option value="w">w</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label><b>f(b):</b> 
      <select id="fb" onchange="actualizarDiagrama()">
        <option value="x">x</option>
        <option value="y" selected>y</option>
        <option value="z">z</option>
        <option value="w">w</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label><b>f(c):</b> 
      <select id="fc" onchange="actualizarDiagrama()">
        <option value="x">x</option>
        <option value="y">y</option>
        <option value="z" selected>z</option>
        <option value="w">w</option>
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <svg id="diagrama" width="400" height="280" style="background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 6px; width: 100%;"></svg>
</div>

<script>
function actualizarDiagrama() {
  const svg = document.getElementById('diagrama');
  const fa = document.getElementById('fa').value;
  const fb = document.getElementById('fb').value;
  const fc = document.getElementById('fc').value;
  
  const posA = { a: 50, b: 140, c: 230 };
  const posB = { x: 35, y: 105, z: 175, w: 245 };
  const parejas = [ {src:'a', tgt:fa}, {src:'b', tgt:fb}, {src:'c', tgt:fc} ];

  let contenido = `
    <defs>
      <marker id="flecha" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="28" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto">
        <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#2b6cb0"/>
      </marker>
    </defs>
    <text x="100" y="20" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold" fill="#2d3748">Conjunto A</text>
    <text x="300" y="20" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold" fill="#2d3748">Conjunto B</text>
  `;

  // Dibujar flechas
  parejas.forEach(p => {
    const y1 = posA[p.src];
    const y2 = posB[p.tgt];
    contenido += `<line x1="100" y1="${y1}" x2="300" y2="${y2}" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#flecha)"/>`;
  });

  // Dibujar Nodos A
  Object.keys(posA).forEach(key => {
    const y = posA[key];
    contenido += `<circle cx="100" cy="${y}" r="18" fill="#ebf8ff" stroke="#3182ce" stroke-width="2"/>`;
    contenido += `<text x="100" y="${y+5}" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold" fill="#2b6cb0">${key}</text>`;
  });

  // Dibujar Nodos B
  Object.keys(posB).forEach(key => {
    const y = posB[key];
    contenido += `<circle cx="300" cy="${y}" r="18" fill="#feebc8" stroke="#dd6b20" stroke-width="2"/>`;
    contenido += `<text x="300" y="${y+5}" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold" fill="#c05621">${key}</text>`;
  });

  svg.innerHTML = contenido;
}

// Inicializar al cargar la página
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", actualizarDiagrama);
actualizarDiagrama();
</script>
